Trimming reads

# Sample_name is a vector of all sample names, which
# are associated with a particular sample and which
# form a regular part of the reads filenames.

# AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA R1 adaptor
# AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT R2 adaptor

while read sample_name # loooop
do
fastp --in1 ${sample_name}_R1_001.fq.fastq --in2 ${sample_name}_R2_001.fq --out1 ${sample_name}_R1_001_P.fq.gz --out2 ${sample_name}_R2_001_P.fq.gz  --unpaired1 ${sample_name}_R1_001_U.fq.gz  --unpaired2 ${sample_name}_R2_001_U.fq.gz  -h ${sample_name}_summary.html --detect_adapter_for_pe --adapter_sequence=AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA  --adapter_sequence_r2=AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT
done < namelist.txt

HybPiper

# mega353.fasta is the AA file we used to assemble target genes

# Making namelist.txt for HybPiper
for uwu in *_R1_001.fq.gz
do
    owo=${uwu%%_R1_001_P.fq}
    echo $owo >> "namelist.txt"
done

# Running HybPiper
while read sample_name
do
    hybpiper assemble -r ${sample_name}*.fastq -t_dna mega353.fasta --prefix ${sample_name} --bwa
done < namelist.txt

# Get run statistics
hybpiper stats -t_dna mega353.fasta gene namelist.txt

# Get heatmap of length recovery
hybpiper recovery_heatmap seq_lengths.tsv

# Recover DNA and amino-acid sequences
hybpiper retrieve_sequences -t_dna mega353.fasta dna --sample_names namelist.txt --fasta_dir 01_dna_seqs
hybpiper retrieve_sequences -t_dna mega353.fasta aa --sample_names namelist.txt --fasta_dir 02_aa_seqs

# Recover paralog sequences
hybpiper paralog_retriever namelist.txt -t_dna mega353.fasta

Plastome assembly

# GetOrganelle produces a plastome, or very clean scaffolds
# MITObim is then used to recruit discarded reads to try to circularize the scaffolds

# GetOrganelle command
# more extension rounds(5 not 3)
# custom wide k-mer range (to improve contiguitiveness)
# custom Pandanus seed
# limits effective coverage to 50x, soft cap for kmer pathways
while read sample_name
do
    get_organelle_from_reads.py -1 CleanedReads/${sample_name}_R1_001_P.fastq -2 CleanedReads/${sample_name}_R2_001_P.fastq -o plastome_output/${sample_name} -t 28 -R 5 -k 21,25,29,33,37,41,45,51,57,63,69,75,81,85 -F embplant_pt -s GoodsOnly/seedOrganelle.fasta --overwrite --reduce-reads-for-coverage 50
done < GoodsOnly/mininames.txt

# Move scaffolds
while read sample_name
do
    echo ${sample_name}
    mkdir MITOtest/${sample_name}
    mv CleanedReads/${sample_name}_R2_001_P.fastq MITOtest/${sample_name}/${sample_name}_R2_001_P.fastq
    
    mv CleanedReads/${sample_name}_R1_001_P.fastq MITOtest/${sample_name}/${sample_name}_R1_001_P.fastq
    
    mv plastome_output/${sample_name}/embplant_pt.K85.scaffolds.graph1.1.path_sequence.fasta MITOtest/${sample_name}/embplant_pt.K85.scaffolds.graph1.1.path_sequence.fasta
    cp seedOrganelle.fasta MITOtest/${sample_name}/seedOrganelle.fasta
done < GoodsOnly/namelistmini.txt

# MITObim
# ten rounds max to reduce noise
while read sample_name
do
    docker run -v /MITOtest/${sample_name}:/data -it mitobim /MITObim.pl -start 1 -end 10 -sample ${sample_name} -ref genome --quick /seedOrganelle.fasta -readpool ${sample_name}_R1_001_P.fastq ${sample_name}_R2_001_P.fastq embplant_pt.K85.scaffolds.graph1.1.path_sequence.fasta -mirapath /usr/local/bin/mira --clean --verbose
done < GoodsOnly/namelistmini.txt

Alignment

# External packages used
remotes::install_github("wojahn/PrideBar")
library(PrideBar)
library(Biostrings)
library(DECIPHER)
library(ape)
library(ips)

# Modern hybrid status was ascertained via HybPhaseR
# PlastomeSamplesNoPandanusHybz.csv is a database of non-modern-hybrid nuclear samples
# NuclearSamplesNoPandanusHybz.csv is a database of non-modern-hybrid plastome samples

allz <- list.files("NuclearGenesUnaligned",full.names = T)
PlastomeSamplesNoPandanusHybz <- read.csv("PlastomeSamplesNoPandanusHybz.csv")
NuclearSamplesNoPandanusHybz <- read.csv("NuclearSamplesNoPandanusHybz.csv")

PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,length(allz),2)
for(i in 1:length(allz))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  uwu <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(allz[i]) # read in sequence
  ThisGenesSampz <- names(uwu)
  nuwu <- which(ThisGenesSampz %in% NuclearSamplesNoPandanusHybz$Nuclear)
  uwu_ch2 <- uwu[nuwu]
  uwu_ch2 <- DECIPHER::RemoveGaps(uwu_ch2) # remove gaps if present (unlikely)
  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(uwu_ch2,"tmp.fasta")
  uwu_ch2 <- ape::read.FASTA("tmp.fasta")
  # Align with MAFFT
  uwu_ch2_al <- ips::mafft(uwu_ch2, method = "auto", maxiterate = 1000, thread = 10)
  ape::write.FASTA(uwu_ch2_al,gsub("unaligned","aligned",gsub("NuclearGenesUnaligned","NuclearGenesAlignedRoundOne_Redo",allz[i])))
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()

Nuclear gene trees and consensus

# External packages used
library(PrideBar)
library(ape)
library(DECIPHER)
library(Biostrings)
library(ips)

# List all aligned nuclear gene FASTA files for round one
MFR <- list.files("NuclearGenesAlignedRoundOne_Redo")

# Preallocate a character vector to store IQ-TREE commands
commz <- rep(NA,length(MFR))

# Construct an IQ-TREE command for each alignment
# -alrt 1000 : SH-aLRT branch support
# -bb 1000   : ultrafast bootstrap
# -nt 1      : single-threaded (for GNU parallel)
for(i in 1:length(MFR))
{
  commz[i] <- sprintf("iqtree -s %s -alrt 1000 -bb 1000 -nt 1",MFR[i])
}

# Write all IQ-TREE commands to a text file for parallel execution
write.table(commz,"NuclearGenesAlignedRoundOne_Redo/AprilCommandsFirst.txt", row.names = F, col.names = F, quote = F)

# Run IQ-TREE in parallel outside R
system("parallel -j 27 < AprilCommandsFirst.txt")

# Read in completed gene trees from round one
MFRD <- list.files("NuclearGenesAlignedRoundOne_Redo_Done",full.names = T)
MFRD <- MFRD[grep(".treefile",MFRD)]

# Initialize a progress bar
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,length(MFRD),2)

# Concatenate all gene trees into a single multi-tree file for ASTRAL
for(i in 1:length(MFRD))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  uwu <- ape::read.tree(MFRD[i])
  if(i == 1)
  {
    # First tree: create file
    ape::write.tree(uwu,"AprilFirstRoundComboTrees.tree", append = F)
  }else{
    # Subsequent trees: append
    ape::write.tree(uwu,"AprilFirstRoundComboTrees.tree", append = T)
  }
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()

# Infer an intermediate species tree from concatenated gene trees using ASTRAL
system("astral -i AprilFirstRoundComboTrees.tree -o AprilFirstRoundSpeciesTree.tree -t 2 -s 35753")

# Load gene trees from round two to collect all taxa present
allz <- list.files("NuclearGenesAlignedRoundTwo_Redo_Done",full.names = T)
allz <- allz[grep(".treefile",allz)]

# Vector to store all unique sample names
allsamps <- c()

# Progress bar for reading trees
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,length(allz),2)
for(i in 1:length(allz))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  uwu <- ape::read.tree(allz[i])
  # Collect unique tip labels across all trees
  allsamps <- c(allsamps,unique(uwu$tip.label))
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()

# Reload round one gene trees for filtering problematic long branches
alltreez <- list.files("NuclearGenesAlignedRoundOne_Redo_Done",full.names = T)
alltreez <- alltreez[grepl("treefile",alltreez)]
library(ape)

# Initialize progress bar
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,length(alltreez),2)

for(i in 1:length(alltreez))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  
  # Read gene tree
  tree <- ape::read.tree(alltreez[i])
  
  # Extract branch lengths
  branch_lengths <- tree$edge.length
  
  # Define outlier threshold (top 5% of branch lengths)
  threshold <- quantile(branch_lengths, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Identify edges with unusually long branches
  tips_above_threshold <- which(branch_lengths > threshold)
  
  # Get child nodes of those edges
  child_nodes <- tree$edge[tips_above_threshold, 2]
  
  # Restrict to terminal nodes (tips)
  tip_indices <- child_nodes[child_nodes <= length(tree$tip.label)]
  tips_labels <- tree$tip.label[tip_indices]
  
  # Remove long-branch tips except for key ingroup taxa
  tips_to_remove <- tips_labels[!grepl("Cyclanthus",tips_labels)] # leave the root
  tips_to_remove <- tips_to_remove[!grepl("Sararanga",tips_to_remove)]
  tips_to_remove <- tips_to_remove[!grepl("Freycinetia",tips_to_remove)]
  tips_to_remove <- tips_to_remove[!grepl("Martellidendron",tips_to_remove)]
  tips_to_remove <- tips_to_remove[!grepl("Benstonea",tips_to_remove)] # leave the root
  
  # Load the corresponding FASTA alignment
  thisfasta <- gsub(".treefile","",alltreez[i])
  thisfasta <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(sprintf("%s",thisfasta))
  
  # Remove sequences associated with long-branch tips
  filtered_sequences <- thisfasta[!(names(thisfasta) %in% tips_to_remove)]
  
  # Remove alignment gaps prior to realignment
  filtered_sequences <- DECIPHER::RemoveGaps(filtered_sequences)
  
  # Write temporary FASTA for MAFFT
  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(filtered_sequences,"uwu.fasta")
  filtered_sequences <- ape::read.FASTA("uwu.fasta")
  
  # Realign filtered sequences using MAFFT
  alz <- ips::mafft(filtered_sequences, thread = 10)
  
  # Write second-round alignments with updated filenames
  thisfasta <- gsub("_first_","_second_", gsub(".treefile","",alltreez[i]))
  ape::write.FASTA(alz,gsub("NuclearGenesAlignedRoundOne_Redo_Done","NuclearGenesAlignedRoundTwo_Redo",thisfasta))
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()

# List all second-round alignments
MFR <- list.files("NuclearGenesAlignedRoundTwo_Redo")

# Generate IQ-TREE commands for round two
commz <- rep(NA,length(MFR))
for(i in 1:length(MFR))
{
  commz[i] <- sprintf("iqtree -s %s -alrt 1000 -bb 1000 -nt 1",MFR[i])
}

# Write second-round IQ-TREE commands to file
write.table(commz,"NuclearGenesAlignedRoundTwo_Redo/AprilCommandsSecond.txt", row.names = F, col.names = F, quote = F)

# Run second-round trees in parallel
system("parallel -j 26 < AprilCommandsSecond.txt")

# Read completed second-round gene trees
MFRD <- list.files("NuclearGenesAlignedRoundTwo_Redo_Done",full.names = T)
MFRD <- MFRD[grep(".treefile",MFRD)]

# Progress bar for concatenation
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,length(MFRD),2)

# Combine second-round gene trees for final ASTRAL analysis
for(i in 1:length(MFRD))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  uwu <- ape::read.tree(MFRD[i])
  if(i == 1)
  {
    ape::write.tree(uwu,"AprilSecondRoundComboTrees.tree", append = F)
  }else{
    ape::write.tree(uwu,"AprilSecondRoundComboTrees.tree", append = T)
  }
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()


# Final species tree inference from cleaned, second-round nuclear gene trees
system("astral -i AprilSecondRoundComboTrees.tree -o AprilSecondRoundNuclear.tree -t 2 -s 35753")

Concatenated nuclear tree

First run BMGE

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Directory containing alignments
ALIGN_DIR="/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/Ch2ReDoFinal/NuclearGenesAlignedRoundTwo_Redo_BMGE"
# Output directory for BMGE-trimmed alignments
OUT_DIR="$ALIGN_DIR/bmge_trimmed"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

# Loop through fasta files
for aln in "$ALIGN_DIR"/*.fasta "$ALIGN_DIR"/*.fa; do
    # Skip if no matching files
    [ -e "$aln" ] || continue

    # Get base name (without path or extension)
    base=$(basename "$aln")
    base="${base%.*}"

    echo "Processing $aln..."

    # Run BMGE
    BMGE \
      -i "$aln" \
      -t DNA \
      -of "$OUT_DIR/${base}_bmge.fasta" \
      -h 0.5
done

echo "BMGE trimming complete. Output in: $OUT_DIR"

  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  allz <- c()
  for(j in 1:length(geneslist))

    if(alltaxa[i] %in% names(geneslist[[j]]))

      thisone <- uwu[names(uwu) == alltaxa[i]]

Plastome tree

# Set working directory for constraint checker scripts
setwd("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/treePL-master/constraint_checker")
source("check_fossils.R");  # Load fossil-checking functions

message("Parsing GenBank File...")

GBFile <- "sequence.gb"  # Input GenBank file
ToAnal <- "AlignedOrderedGoodPlastomes_First.fasta"  # Aligned plastome sequences

library(genbankr)
PanTecGB <- genbankr::parseGenBank(GBFile)  # Parse GenBank file

message("...extracting features")
PanTecGB_f <- PanTecGB[["FEATURES"]]  # Extract FEATURES from GenBank object

# Prepare an empty dataframe to store feature info
Infoz <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=0,ncol=5))
colnames(Infoz) <- c("start","end","strand","type","name")

# Progress bar setup for feature extraction
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,length(PanTecGB_f),2)

# Loop over all features in GenBank file
for(i in 1:length(PanTecGB_f))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()  # Update progress bar
  tmp <- as.data.frame(PanTecGB_f[[i]])  # Convert feature to data frame

  # If the feature has only one row
  if(nrow(tmp) == 1)
  {
    toadd <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=1,ncol=5))
    colnames(toadd) <- c("start","end","strand","type","name")
    toadd[1,1] <- tmp[1,2]
    toadd[1,2] <- tmp[1,3]
    toadd[1,3] <- tmp[1,4]
    toadd[1,4] <- tmp[1,5]
    toadd[1,5] <- tmp[1,6]
    Infoz <- rbind(Infoz,toadd)  # Append to Infoz
  }else{
    # If feature has multiple rows, loop over each row
    toadd <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(tmp),ncol=5))
    colnames(toadd) <- c("start","end","strand","type","name")
    for(j in 1:nrow(tmp))
    {
      toadd[j,1] <- tmp[j,2]
      toadd[j,2] <- tmp[j,3]
      toadd[j,3] <- tmp[j,4]
      toadd[j,4] <- tmp[j,5]
      toadd[j,5] <- tmp[j,6]
    }
    Infoz <- rbind(Infoz,toadd)  # Append all rows
  }
}

PrideBar::FadePrideBar()  # Finish progress bar

# Read aligned plastome sequences
AWD <- seqinr::read.fasta(ToAnal)

message("...isolating reference")
# Identify reference sequence
AWD_ref <- as.character(AWD[[which(names(AWD) == "Pandanus_tectorius_{Wang_B247}_TEMPLATE")]])

# Create a mapping of non-gap positions
themz <- which(as.character(AWD_ref) != "-")
TruNumz <- rep(NA, length(AWD_ref))
for(i in 1:length(themz))
{
  TruNumz[as.numeric(themz[i])] <- i
}

# Convert all sequences to a dataframe (rows=sequences, columns=positions)
uwu <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(AWD),ncol=length(as.character(AWD[[1]]))))
for(i in 1:length(AWD))
{
  message(sprintf("Processing No. %s of %s",i,length(AWD)))
  uwu[i,] <- as.vector(as.character(AWD[[i]]))
}

# Extract indices for different plastome regions
LSCi <- Infoz[Infoz$name == "large single copy region (LSC)",]
IRBi <- Infoz[Infoz$name == "inverted repeat B (IRB)",]
SSCi <- Infoz[Infoz$name == "small single copy region (SSC)",]
IRAi <- Infoz[Infoz$name == "inverted repeat A (IRA)",]

# Map reference positions to real sequence numbers
countR <- 0
RealNumz <- rep(NA, length(AWD_ref))
for(i in 1:length(AWD_ref))
{
  if(AWD_ref[i] != "-")
  {
    countR <- countR + 1
    RealNumz[i] <- countR
  }
}

# Create numeric position vectors for each region
LSCnumz <- seq(LSCi[1,1],LSCi[1,2],1)
IRBnumz <- seq(IRBi[1,1],IRBi[1,2],1)
SSCnumz <- seq(SSCi[1,1],SSCi[1,2],1)
IRAnumz <- seq(IRAi[1,1],IRAi[1,2],1)

# Extract columns corresponding to each plastome region
LSC_only <- uwu[,seq(which(RealNumz == LSCi[1,1]),which(RealNumz == LSCi[1,2]))]
IRB_only <- uwu[,seq(which(RealNumz == IRBi[1,1]),which(RealNumz == IRBi[1,2]))]
SSC_only <- uwu[,seq(which(RealNumz == SSCi[1,1]),which(RealNumz == SSCi[1,2]))]
IRA_only <- uwu[,seq(which(RealNumz == IRAi[1,1]),which(RealNumz == IRAi[1,2]))]

# LSC
LSC <- LSC_only
tmp <- LSC

# Collapse rows into DNA strings
dna_sequences <- apply(tmp, 1, paste, collapse = "")
names(dna_sequences) <- names(AWD)

# Prepare FASTA lines

# Combine sequences by concatenating LSC+IRB+SSC for each sample
combine_sequences <- function(f1, f2, f3) {
  all_names <- names(f1)  # Use sample names from LSC
  combined_seqs <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(sapply(all_names, function(n) {
    paste0(f1[n], f2[n], f3[n])  # Concatenate sequences
  }))
  names(combined_seqs) <- all_names
  return(combined_seqs)
}

combined_fasta <- combine_sequences(fasta1, fasta2, fasta3)
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(combined_fasta, "April_LSC-IRB-SSC_Plastomes_Aligned_RoundOne.fasta")

# Pruning

tree <- ape::read.tree("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/Ch2ReDoFinal/RoundOneMLPlastomeTreeApril.tree")
branch_lengths <- tree$edge.length
threshold <- quantile(branch_lengths, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)  # Identify extreme branches

# Identify tips on long branches
tips_above_threshold <- which(branch_lengths > threshold)
child_nodes <- tree$edge[tips_above_threshold, 2]
tip_indices <- child_nodes[child_nodes <= length(tree$tip.label)]
tips_labels <- tree$tip.label[tip_indices]

# Remove all tips except specified root taxa
tips_to_remove <- tips_labels[!grepl("Cyclanthus",tips_labels)]
thisfasta <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/Ch2ReDoFinal/April_LSC-IRB-SSC_Plastomes_Aligned_RoundOne.fasta")
tips_to_remove_dummy <- gsub("_Pandanus_","",tips_to_remove)
tips_to_remove <- tips_to_remove[grep("Pandanus_",tips_to_remove_dummy)]
filtered_sequences <- thisfasta[!(names(thisfasta) %in% tips_to_remove)]
filtered_sequences <- DECIPHER::RemoveGaps(filtered_sequences)
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(filtered_sequences,"uwu.fasta")
filtered_sequences <- ape::read.FASTA("uwu.fasta")
alz <- ips::mafft(filtered_sequences, method = "auto", maxiterate = 1000, thread = 10, quiet = F)
ape::write.FASTA(alz,"April_LSC-IRB-SSC_Plastomes_Aligned_RoundTwo.fasta")

# External packages used
library(phangorn)
library(PrideBar)
library(ape)

# General structure 
#     Pre-processing gene trees
#     Analyses tipwise distributions
#     First analysis: hand-picked taxa from distribition matrix
#     Second analysis: bootstrapping optimization of tip choice
#     .....maximized tip number
#     .....maximized tree number
#     .....balanced optimalisation

# Splits analysis requires all trees to have exactly the same tip names
# and exactly the same number of tips in every tree. If you just restrict all
# gene trees to shared species, very few species are in every one.
# This is a classical optimization problem where the need to include
#  the best number of tips and the best number of genes must be balanced.

#     Pre-processing gene trees
trees <- ape::read.tree("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/Networks/AprilSecondRoundComboTrees.tree")
trees_fixed <- list()
# Fix them
UniTaxo <- read.csv("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Three/Unitaxo_spp_formal_Ch3.csv")
MasterTaxo <- read.csv("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/MasterTaxonomyOctober2025.csv")
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1, length(trees),1)
for(j in 1:length(trees))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  owo <- trees[[j]]
  taxa <- owo$tip.label
  MasterTaxo_g <- MasterTaxo[MasterTaxo$RemoveTip == 0,1]
  MasterTaxo_g <- MasterTaxo_g[!MasterTaxo_g == ""]
  determinationz <- c()
  for(i in 1:length(taxa))
  {
    if(T %in% grepl(taxa[i],MasterTaxo_g))
    {
      determinationz <- c(determinationz,i)
    }else{
      # nothing
    }
  }
  taxa <- taxa[determinationz]
  owo <- ape::keep.tip(owo, taxa)
  taxa <- owo$tip.label
  UniTaxo <- read.csv("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Three/Unitaxo_spp_formal_Ch3.csv")
  unified <- rep(NA,length(taxa))
  for(i in 1:length(taxa))
  {
    #print(i)
    original <- taxa[i]
    if(length(grep(original,UniTaxo$Nuclear)) > 0)
    {
      unified[i] <- sprintf("%s_(%s)",UniTaxo[grep(original,UniTaxo$Nuclear),4],UniTaxo[grep(original,UniTaxo$Nuclear),5])
    }else{
      unified[i] <- "BAD"
    }
  }
  owo$tip.label <- unified
  taxa <- unified[-which(unified == "BAD")]
  if(length(taxa) > 0)
  {
    owo <- ape::keep.tip(owo, taxa)
  }
  trees_fixed[[j]] <- owo
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()

#     Second analysis: bootstrapping optimization of tip choice

# optimisation code
balanz <- matrix(nrow=length(names(tipz_t)),ncol=2)
themz <- c()
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,length(names(tipz_t)),2)
for(i in 1:length(names(tipz_t)))
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  themz <- c(themz,names(tipz_t)[i])
  treezinz <- rep(NA,length(trees_fixed))
  for(j in 1:length(trees_fixed))
  {
    owo <- trees_fixed[[j]]
    owotipz <- owo$tip.label
    if(!F %in% (themz %in% owotipz))
    {
      treezinz[j] <- T
    }else{
      treezinz[j] <- F
    }
  }
  balanz[i,1] <- length(themz)
  balanz[i,2] <- length(which(treezinz))
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()
balanz <- as.data.frame(balanz)
colnames(balanz) <- c("Number of Tips","Number of Genes")
pdf("Raw_Genes_Tips_Optimization.pdf")
plot(balanz)
dev.off()

# Ok, so lets do bootstraps to explore "tip choice space"
# Brute force itwith 1000 bootstraps!!!
tipnumz <- c()
treenumz <- c()
namez <- c()
set.seed(35753) # this seed satisfies my OCD
minimz <- 10 # minimum tip number
PrideBar::SetPrideBar(minimz,100,2)
for(i in minimz:100)
{
  PrideBar::PrideBar()
  for(j in 1:1000)
  {
    thisone <- sample(tipz_t,i)
    themz <- names(thisone)
    treezinz <- rep(NA,length(trees_fixed))
    for(j in 1:length(trees_fixed))
    {
      owo <- trees_fixed[[j]]
      owotipz <- owo$tip.label
      if(!F %in% (themz %in% owotipz))
      {
        treezinz[j] <- T
      }else{
        treezinz[j] <- F
      }
    }
    treenumz <- c(treenumz,length(which(treezinz)))
    tipnumz <- c(tipnumz,i)
    namez <- c(namez,paste(names(thisone),collapse=";"))
  }
}
PrideBar::FadePrideBar()

optires <- data.frame(treenumz,tipnumz)
optires_n <- data.frame(treenumz,tipnumz,namez)
write.csv(optires_n,"optimisation_results.csv",row.names=F)
optires_n <- read.csv("optimisation_results.csv")
pdf("TipVsTreesPlot.pdf")
plot(optires)
dev.off()

# So, we have three optimums:
# 1: the max genes one, which is the larges gene point over a threshold of
# at least 10 taxa.
# 2: the max taxa one, which is the larges gene point over a threshold of
# at least 10 genes
# 3: the value that maximizes both values, i.e.,
# treenumz+treenumz-abs(treenumz-tipnumz)

chronos_CIs <- function(tree, calibration, n_bootstrap = 100, lambda = 1) {
  control <- list(
    tol = 1e-5,             # relaxed tolerance (faster, less strict)
    iter.max = 1500,        # more iterations for convergence
    eval.max = 3000,        # more evaluations to prevent early stops
    nb.rate.cat = 10,       # keep for rate heterogeneity
    dual.iter.max = 1000,   # dual optimization iterations
    epsilon = 1e-7          # relaxed convergence criterion
  )

  cat("Running initial dating on original tree...\n")
  original_dated <- chronos(tree, lambda = lambda, model = "correlated",
                            calibration = calibration, control = control, quiet = TRUE)
  original_ages <- branching.times(original_dated)

  bootstrap_ages <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_bootstrap, ncol = length(original_ages))
  colnames(bootstrap_ages) <- names(original_ages)

  cat("Running", n_bootstrap, "bootstrap replicates...\n")
  PrideBar::SetPrideBar(1,n_bootstrap,2)
  fail_count <- 0
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    if (i %% 10 == 0) cat("Bootstrap", i, "of", n_bootstrap, "\n")
    PrideBar::PrideBar()
    # Perturb branch lengths with milder noise
    boot_tree <- tree
    boot_tree$edge.length <- tree$edge.length * rlnorm(length(tree$edge.length),
                                                       meanlog = 0,
                                                       sdlog = 0.05)

    # Date bootstrap tree
    tryCatch({
      boot_dated <- chronos(boot_tree, lambda = lambda, model = "correlated",
                            calibration = calibration, control = control, quiet = TRUE)
      bootstrap_ages[i, ] <- branching.times(boot_dated)
    }, error = function(e) {
      fail_count <<- fail_count + 1
      cat("Bootstrap", i, "failed\n")
    })
  }
  PrideBar::FadePrideBar()
  cat("Bootstrap complete. Failed replicates:", fail_count, "out of", n_bootstrap, "\n")

  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  ci_results <- data.frame(
    Node = names(original_ages),
    Mean_Age = original_ages,
    CI_2.5 = apply(bootstrap_ages, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    CI_97.5 = apply(bootstrap_ages, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = apply(bootstrap_ages, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  return(list(ages = ci_results, bootstrap_matrix = bootstrap_ages))
}

    nb.rate.cat = 10,       # keep for rate heterogeneity
    dual.iter.max = 1000,   # dual optimization iterations
    epsilon = 1e-7          # relaxed convergence criterion
  )
original_dated <- chronos(tree, lambda = 1, model = "correlated",
                            calibration = calibration, control = control, quiet = F)

# Calculate CIs (this takes 5-10 minutes)

plot_chronos_CIs_simple <- function(dated_tree, ci_results, max_nodes = 1000) {

    # Calculate tree depth
    tree_depth <- max(node.depth.edgelength(dated_tree))

    # Set max limit explicitly for x-axis (make sure it covers 150 or tree_depth if bigger)
    x_max <- max(150, tree_depth + 5)  # +5 for padding

    library(phyloch)
    data(strat2012)    # Plot tree with x.lim explicitly set to cover full range
    plot(dated_tree, show.tip.label = FALSE, edge.width = 1.2,
         x.lim = c(0, x_max))

    # Add time axis
    axisPhylo(side = 3)
    phyloch::axisGeo(strat2012, tip.time = 0, unit = c("epoch","period"),    gridty = 0, gridcol = "black",ages=F)

    # Get node coordinates from the plot
    last_plot <- get("last_plot.phylo", envir = .PlotPhyloEnv)

    # Define transparent blue color
    transparent_blue <- rgb(0, 0, 1, alpha = 0.4)  # blue with 40% opacity

    # Add CI bars for the first max_nodes (to avoid clutter)
    n_nodes <- min(max_nodes, nrow(ci_results))

    for(i in 1:n_nodes) {
        node_num <- as.numeric(ci_results$Node[i])

        # Check if node exists in plot coordinates
        if(node_num <= length(last_plot$xx) && !is.na(last_plot$xx[node_num])) {

            # Get plot coordinates
            y_pos <- last_plot$yy[node_num]

            # Convert ages to x coordinates
            mean_x <- tree_depth - ci_results$Mean_Age[i]
            lower_x <- tree_depth - ci_results$CI_97.5[i]
            upper_x <- tree_depth - ci_results$CI_2.5[i]

            # Draw CI bar with transparent blue
            segments(lower_x, y_pos, upper_x, y_pos, col = transparent_blue, lwd = 6)
            # Draw end caps with transparent blue
            segments(lower_x, y_pos - 0.4, lower_x, y_pos + 0.4, col = transparent_blue, lwd = 6)
            segments(upper_x, y_pos - 0.4, upper_x, y_pos + 0.4, col = transparent_blue, lwd = 6)
            # Draw mean point
            #points(mean_x, y_pos, col = "blue", pch = 16, cex = 1.2)
        }
    }

    # Add legend
    #legend("topleft",
    #       legend = c("95% CI"),
    #       col = c(transparent_blue),
     #      pch = c(16, NA),
     #      lty = c(NA, 1),
      #     lwd = c(NA, 6),
      #     cex = 0.8)

   # title("Pandanus Phylogeny with Confidence Intervals")
}

write.tree.with.semicolons <- function(tree, file)
{
  # Load ape just in case
  if (!requireNamespace("ape", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ape' is required but not installed.")
  }

  # 1. Escape semicolons in all labels
  if (!is.null(tree$tip.label))
    tree$tip.label <- gsub(";", "_SEMICOLON_", tree$tip.label, fixed = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(tree$node.label))
    tree$node.label <- gsub(";", "_SEMICOLON_", tree$node.label, fixed = TRUE)

  # 2. Write the tree using ape (semicolons temporarily replaced)
  tmpfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".tre")
  ape::write.tree(tree, file = tmpfile)

  # 3. Read the written text and restore the real semicolons
  txt <- readLines(tmpfile, warn = FALSE)
  txt <- gsub("_SEMICOLON_", ";", txt, fixed = TRUE)

  # 4. Write the final corrected text to the desired file
  writeLines(txt, file)

  invisible(file)
}

# Write it out preserving semicolons
write.tree.with.semicolons(rawtree,"/Users/Mike/Downloads/VM/ReadyForPhyTop_smolbl.tree")

Dsuite


#!/bin/bash

VCF_DIR="VCFs"
OUT_DIR="Dsuite_Output"
SETS_FILE="SETS.txt"
TREE_FILE="GroupTree.nwk"
DSUITE="./Dsuite/Build/Dsuite"  # adjust if Dsuite is elsewhere

# List of required outgroup samples (space-separated)
OUTGROUP_SAMPLES=(
    "Panda-0316-44590058_S33_L002_Benstonea_copelandii_Not_Pandanus"
    "Panda-0470-44589987_S735_L001_Benstonea_nana_Not_Pandanus"
    "Callmander-1010_S253_L008_Benstonea_alticola_Not_Pandanus"
)

mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

for vcf in "$VCF_DIR"/*.vcf "$VCF_DIR"/*.vcf.gz; do
    [ -e "$vcf" ] || continue
    base=$(basename "$vcf")
    prefix="${base%%.*}"

    # Get samples in this VCF
    samples=$(bcftools query -l "$vcf")

    # Check if any outgroup sample is present
    found_outgroup=0
    for out in "${OUTGROUP_SAMPLES[@]}"; do
        if echo "$samples" | grep -qx "$out"; then
            found_outgroup=1
            break
        fi
    done

    if [ $found_outgroup -eq 1 ]; then
        echo "Running Dsuite on $base ..."
        "$DSUITE" Dtrios -t "$TREE_FILE" "$vcf" "$SETS_FILE" -o "$OUT_DIR/${prefix}"
    else
        echo "Skipping $base - no outgroup samples found"
    fi
done

combine_files=$(ls "$OUT_DIR/"*_combine.txt 2>/dev/null)

if [ -z "$combine_files" ]; then
    echo "No *_combine.txt files found to combine."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Combining all results with DtriosCombine..."
"$DSUITE" DtriosCombine "$OUT_DIR/combined_results" $combine_files


echo "Done! Combined results in $OUT_DIR/combined_results.trios.txt"

# Function for AICc
calc_AICc <- function(lnL, k, n) {
  AIC <- 2*k - 2*lnL
  AICc <- AIC + (2*k*(k+1)) / (n - k - 1)
  return(AICc)
}

# Function for AICc
calc_AICc <- function(lnL, k, n) {
  AIC <- 2*k - 2*lnL
  AICc <- AIC + (2*k*(k+1)) / (n - k - 1)
  return(AICc)
}

# Convert DMS to Decimal Degrees
dms_to_dd <- function(degree, minute, second, direction) 
{
  dd <- as.numeric(degree) + as.numeric(minute) / 60 + as.numeric(second) / 3600
  if (direction %in% c("S", "W")) {
    dd <- -dd
  }
  return(dd)
}

# Function to extract and convert
extract_and_convert <- function(text)
{
  # Match both coordinates
match <- str_match(text, "(\\d{1,3})°(\\d{1,2})'(\\d{1,2}(?:\\.\\d+)?)\"?([NS])\\s*(\\d{1,3})°(\\d{1,2})'(\\d{1,2}(?:\\.\\d+)?)\"?([EW])")
  if (any(is.na(match))) return(data.frame(latitude = NA, longitude = NA))

  lat <- dms_to_dd(match[2], match[3], match[4], match[5])
  lon <- dms_to_dd(match[6], match[7], match[8], match[9])

  return(data.frame(latitude = lat, longitude = lon))
}

# Apply to all rows
result <- do.call(rbind, lapply(coords, extract_and_convert))
rownames(result) <- NULL

    varselrf_pandan <- varSelRF::varSelRF(both,

                                          recompute.var.imp=F,
                                          whole.range=T,
                                          ntree=100000, # Lots of trees
                                          ntreeIterat=100000, # Lots of iterations
                                          keep.forest = TRUE,
                                          verbose=TRUE,
                                          vars.drop.num=1, # Fine dropping

    nomenz <- rownames(II)[rownames(II) %in% gsub("\\/","and",SelectedVars)]

    print(SelectedVars)

    meanz2 <- rep(NA,length(nomenz))

    Resultz$Wilcoxan[i] <- paste(Wilcoxz,collapse=";")
    gc()
  }

  rez <- read.csv("/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/Ch2ReDoFinal/SoilsResults.csv")

  OUT <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=nrow(rez),ncol=4))

  for(i in 1:nrow(rez))
  {
    namez <- as.character(unlist(strsplit(rez[i,2], split = ";")))
    comp1 <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(rez[i,4],split=";")))
    comp2 <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(rez[i,5],split=";")))
    meanz <- (comp1 + comp2)/2
    comp1 <- comp1/meanz*100
    comp2 <- comp2/meanz*100
    goodz1 <- which(comp1 > 110 | comp1 < 90)
    goodz2 <- which(comp2 > 110 | comp2 < 90)
    goodz <- unique(c(goodz1,goodz2))
    OUT[i,2] <- paste(namez[goodz],collapse=";")
    OUT[i,3] <- paste(comp1[goodz],collapse=";")
    OUT[i,4] <- paste(comp2[goodz],collapse=";")
  }

# Load libraries
library(gggenomes)
library(ggplot2)
library(genbankr)
library(GenomicRanges)
# -------------------------------
# 1. Read GenBank plastome
# -------------------------------
OUT_s <- OUT
gb_file <- "/Users/Mike/Main_Drive/Dissertation_Chapter_Two/Ch2ReDoFinal/sequence.gb"
gb <- readGenBank(gb_file)

# Extract CDS features
cds_feats <- gb@cds

# Build features table
featsr <- data.frame(
  seq_id = "plastome",
  start = start(cds_feats),
  end   = end(cds_feats),
  strand = ifelse(strand(cds_feats) == "+", 1, -1),
  gene = mcols(cds_feats)$gene,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

owo <- c(OUT_s$PC_I,OUT_s$PC_II)
owo <- owo[!is.na(owo)]
owo <- as.numeric(owo)
min(owo) #0
max(owo) #1.85
# -------------------------------
# 2. Prepare omega table
# -------------------------------
omega_column <- "PC_I"  # choose which omega column to map
OUT_s_num <- OUT_s
OUT_s_num[, omega_column] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OUT_s_num[, omega_column]))
# Merge omega into feats
feats <- merge(featsr, OUT_s_num[, c("Gene", omega_column)],
               by.x = "gene", by.y = "Gene", all.x = TRUE)

# Ensure numeric omega
feats[[omega_column]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(feats[[omega_column]]))

# -------------------------------
# 3. Prepare sequence table
# -------------------------------
seqs <- data.frame(seq_id = "plastome",
                   length = max(feats$end))

# -------------------------------
# 4. Linear genome plot
# -------------------------------
p <- gggenomes(seqs = seqs, genes = feats) +
  geom_seq(size = 0.5) +
  geom_gene(aes(fill = !!sym(omega_column)), size = 5) +   # all genes on same side
  geom_gene_label(aes(label = gene), hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", na.value = "grey", limits = c(min(owo),max(owo))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle(expression(paste("Linear plastome map with ", omega, " values")))



# -------------------------------
# 5. Save to PDF
# -------------------------------
pdf("PCI_plastome.pdf", width = 70, height = 5)
print(p)
dev.off()

      wstAll[i] <- NewNuc[NewNuc$Tip == All_tree$tip.label[i],5]
    }
    names(wstAll) <- All_tree$tip.label
    
    #wstHHWST <- wstHHWST[-c(which(wstHHWST == ""),which(is.na(wstHHWST)))]
    
    # Normies
    
    Normie_tree$edge.length[is.na(Normie_tree$edge.length)] <- 1e-6
    message("Fitting models")
    library(geiger)
    ERmod <- fitDiscrete(Normie_tree, wstNormies,
                model = "ER",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    ARDmod <- fitDiscrete(Normie_tree, wstNormies,
                model = "ARD",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    # Way bigger than ER, so no need for more iterations
    SYMmod <- fitDiscrete(Normie_tree, wstNormies,
                model = "SYM",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    # Way bigger than ER, so no need for more iterations
    AICcResultz <- c(ERmod$opt$aicc,ARDmod$opt$aicc,SYMmod$opt$aicc)
    AICcResultzNamez <- c("ER","ARD","SYM")
    BestModel <- AICcResultzNamez[AICcResultz == min(AICcResultz)]
    message(sprintf("Best model is: %s",BestModel))
    message("Making SIMMAP")
    #msc_tree_r <- ape::root(msc_tree,"Sararanga_sinuosa_Callmander_919")
    mtree<-make.simmap(Normie_tree,wstNormies,model=BestModel,pi="fitzjohn")#,Q="mcmc",verbose=T)

    mk_model_Normie <- fitMk(mtree, wstNormies, model=BestModel,pi="fitzjohn")

    # HHWST

    HHWST_tree$edge.length[is.na(HHWST_tree$edge.length)] <- 1e-6
    message("Fitting models")
    library(geiger)
    ERmod <- fitDiscrete(HHWST_tree, wstHHWST,
                model = "ER",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    ARDmod <- fitDiscrete(HHWST_tree, wstHHWST,
                model = "ARD",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    # Way bigger than ER, so no need for more iterations
    SYMmod <- fitDiscrete(HHWST_tree, wstHHWST,
                model = "SYM",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    # Way bigger than ER, so no need for more iterations
    AICcResultz <- c(ERmod$opt$aicc,ARDmod$opt$aicc,SYMmod$opt$aicc)
    AICcResultzNamez <- c("ER","ARD","SYM")
    BestModel <- AICcResultzNamez[AICcResultz == min(AICcResultz)]
    message(sprintf("Best model is: %s",BestModel))
    message("Making SIMMAP")
    #msc_tree_r <- ape::root(msc_tree,"Sararanga_sinuosa_Callmander_919")
    HHWST_tree_mtree<-make.simmap(HHWST_tree,wstHHWST,model=BestModel,pi="fitzjohn")#,Q="mcmc",verbose=T)

    mk_model_HHWST <- fitMk(HHWST_tree_mtree, wstHHWST, model=BestModel,pi="fitzjohn")

    # All
    
    All_tree$edge.length[is.na(All_tree$edge.length)] <- 1e-6
    message("Fitting models")
    library(geiger)
    ERmod <- fitDiscrete(All_tree, wstAll,
                model = "ER",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    ARDmod <- fitDiscrete(ml_tree, wstAll,
                model = "ARD",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    # Way bigger than ER, so no need for more iterations
    SYMmod <- fitDiscrete(ml_tree, wstAll,
                model = "SYM",FAIL = 1e+200,ncores=10,control = list(method = c("L-BFGS-B")))
    # Way bigger than ER, so no need for more iterations
    AICcResultz <- c(ERmod$opt$aicc,ARDmod$opt$aicc,SYMmod$opt$aicc)
    AICcResultzNamez <- c("ER","ARD","SYM")
    BestModel <- AICcResultzNamez[AICcResultz == min(AICcResultz)]
    message(sprintf("Best model is: %s",BestModel))
    message("Making SIMMAP")
    #msc_tree_r <- ape::root(msc_tree,"Sararanga_sinuosa_Callmander_919")
    all_tree_mtree<-make.simmap(ml_tree,wst,model=BestModel,pi="fitzjohn")#,Q="mcmc",verbose=T)

    mk_model_all <- fitMk(all_tree_mtree, wst, model=BestModel,pi="fitzjohn")

    
    # Compare AIC values for each model
aic_hhwst <- AIC(mk_model_HHWST)
aic_normie <- AIC(mk_model_Normie)
aic_all <- AIC(mk_model_all)

# Print the AIC values
cat("AIC for HHWST model: ", aic_hhwst, "\n")
cat("AIC for Normal model: ", aic_normie, "\n")
cat("AIC for Combined model: ", aic_all, "\n")


tree_pruned <- ml_tree
# Extract number of parameters (k) from model
k_hhwst <- length(mk_model_HHWST$rates)  # Number of parameters
n_hhwst <- length(tree_pruned$tip.label)  # Number of tips (sample size)

# Calculate AICc for HHWST model
aicc_hhwst <- aic_hhwst + (2 * k_hhwst * (k_hhwst + 1)) / (n_hhwst - k_hhwst - 1)
cat("AICc for HHWST model: ", aicc_hhwst, "\n")

# Repeat the same for Normal and Combined models
k_normie <- length(mk_model_Normie$rates)
n_normie <- length(tree_pruned$tip.label)

aicc_normie <- aic_normie + (2 * k_normie * (k_normie + 1)) / (n_normie - k_normie - 1)
cat("AICc for Normal model: ", aicc_normie, "\n")

k_all <- length(mk_model_all$rates)
n_all <- length(tree_pruned$tip.label)

aicc_all <- aic_all + (2 * k_all * (k_all + 1)) / (n_all - k_all - 1)
cat("AICc for Combined model: ", aicc_all, "\n")


# Log-Likelihoods

logLik_Normie <- logLik(mk_model_Normie)
logLik_All <- logLik(mk_model_all)

tree <- datedtree
# Rescale tree to absolute ages if not already

tree$edge.length <- tree$edge.length / max(node.depth.edgelength(tree)) * tree_height

# -----------------------------

  pos = "bottom",
  abbrv = FALSE,
  fill = NA,
  col = NA
    # only shows text labels, avoids duplication
)

# -----------------------------
p <- p +
  geom_fruit(
    data = morpho_data,
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(x = 1, y = species, fill = LeafShape),
    width = 5,      # wider tiles
    offset = 0.00   # close to tree
  ) +
  geom_fruit(
    data = morpho_data,
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(x = 1, y = species, fill = FlowerColor),
    width = 5,
    offset = 0.05    # slight offset
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.value = "white")
